mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and sacubitril may have minor CYP3A4 inhibitory effects; additive anticholinergic effects may occur with tolterodine's antimuscarinic activity potentially opposing sacubitril's hemodynamic benefits.
action: Monitor for reduced efficacy of sacubitril and anticholinergic adverse effects; consider alternative anticholinergic agents with different metabolism or use lowest effective tolterodine dose with clinical monitoring.
